audience: construction teams who manage jobsite tasks and plans in Fieldwire

useCases.title: List open tasks on a project
useCases.text: The AI lists the tasks (punch items, issues) of a project by status, team, location or owner, with priority and dates.

useCases.title: Review RFIs and submittals
useCases.text: The AI lists RFIs of a project by status, assignee or overdue, with question, answer and due date, and also submittals with their status.

useCases.title: Read inspection and daily report forms
useCases.text: The AI lists forms of a project and reads one with its sections and filled-in values.

useCases.title: Look up plans, sheets and attachments
useCases.text: The AI lists the plans and sheets of a project with versions and file links, and the photos and files attached.

useCases.title: Create a task on a project
useCases.text: The AI creates a task with name, owner, priority and the team and location you pick.

useCases.title: Update a task's status, assignees or dates
useCases.text: The AI changes the status, owner, assignees, priority or dates of a task. It does not delete the task.
